title: sre-weekly-ops-sync-prep-2026-03-04-draft
content:
Purpose: prep notes for SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review (quick briefing for execs + oncall).

Meeting details (draft agenda):
- Quick status (2 mins): error budget, oncall load, infra capacity highlights.
- SLO health snapshot (5 mins): current burn, regressions, remediation plan.
- Paging trends & root causes (10 mins): trends since last sync, actionable items.
- Top incidents review (15 mins): postmortem highlights, mitigation completed, follow-ups.
- Capacity & upcoming deploy risks (5 mins): planned infra changes, canary windows.
- Action items + owners (3 mins).

Notes / talking points:
1) SLO snapshot (as of 2026-03-04)
   - API availability SLO (ingress): Target 99.95% (monthly).
   - Current month to date: 99.86% -> ~0.09% below target (~39% of monthly error budget used).
   - Token-generation latency SLO (p99 <= 850ms): Current p99 = 920ms (up from 760ms last week).
   - Embeddings service availability: Target 99.9%, MTD 99.98% (good).

   Quick explainers: recent backend queueing during burst windows (affecting p99 gen) + one fallback model routing misconfiguration led to increased errors for a 3h window (INC-4523).

2) Paging trends (last 14 days)
   - Total PD pages last 14d: 48 (vs 32 previous 14d) -> ~50% increase.
   - Pages by category: infra/EC2/GPU nodes (18), model fallback/compat issues (12), networking/transit (6), application errors (12).
   - Oncall burden: average pages per PD rotation increased from 5 to 8; mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) stable at ~3.2m, mean time to resolve (MTTR) slipped from 28m -> 46m (due to tiered escalation and deep GPU node restarts).

   Observations: uptick aligns with two larger deploys last week and a spike in PLG customer traffic on Tuesday 02-Mar (traffic x2 baseline for 90m). Need to confirm if autoscale policies handled spike or if manual capacity additions occurred.

3) Top incidents (to review)
   - INC-4523 (2026-03-02): model routing misconfig between hosted API and dedicated pools -> ~3h elevated 500s for a subset of routes.
     - Root cause: routing rule precedence mismatch after canary config rollout.
     - Mitigation: rollback to previous routing policy at 02:45 UTC, temporary increase of dedicated pool capacity.
     - Follow-ups: add unit test/CI gate for routing priority (JIRA-OPS-3456), add a pre-deploy smoke that simulates variant routing (OWNER: Jordan Lee, due 2026-03-18).

   - INC-4550 (2026-02-27): noisy GPU node restarts in a single AZ causing autoscaler thrashing and transient queuing.
     - Root cause: kernel upgrade + driver mismatch during patch window; kubelet evictions triggered pod churn.
     - Mitigation: cordon + rolling restart of node group, driver downgrade on affected nodes.
     - Follow-ups: create a runbook for expedited driver rollback and add alert when restart rate > 3/hr (OWNER: Ethan Chen, due 2026-03-11).

   - Incident cluster (ongoing alerts): intermittent p99 latency spikes tied to prefix cache misses for long-running chat sessions. Investigating KV cache eviction tuning and TTL heuristics.
     - Temporary mitigation: increase cache size on hot shards (manual) and enable sticky routing for active sessions.
     - Follow-ups: perf test with extended session traces; if cache tuning insufficient, schedule a quantized model variant fallback path (OWNER: Aisha Khan, due 2026-03-10).

4) Capacity / upcoming deploy risks
   - Planned infra work: GPU driver update (canary window 2026-03-09). Risk: repeating INC-4550 behavior if we don't gate drivers with node image tests. Proposal: add a pre-driver-upgrade cluster canary (1 node pool) and test against synthetic high-concurrency workload for 6 hours. (OWNER: Samira Patel + infra team, due 2026-03-06 to prepare canary).
   - Autoscaler configs: observed slow scale-up during sudden traffic bursts; propose lowering scale-up cooldown and enabling warm standby nodes for high-traffic routes. Need cost trade-off analysis.

5) Metrics / dashboards to surface in sync
   - Error budget burn (rolling 7d and MTD) per product route.
   - Pages per rotation + MTTR trend.
   - p99 token gen latency by route and model family.
   - Node restart rate and pod churn events (alerts overlay).
   - Model fallback rate and reasons (capacity vs compatibility).

6) Talking points for exec reliability review
   - We're seeing concentrated error budget usage from two operational vectors: deploy/regression (routing rules) and infra upgrades (drivers). Both are addressable with improved pre-deploy gating and targeted runbooks.
   - Short-term: focus on driver canary, routing CI gate, and tighter autoscale policies for critical routes.
   - Mid-term: invest in model routing regression tests + synthetic traffic harness for load safety.

7) Action items (clear, short):
   - Add routing precedence unit test to infra CI (owner: Jordan Lee, due: 2026-03-18).
   - Implement alert for node restart rate >3/hr and add runbook link (owner: Ethan Chen, due: 2026-03-11).
   - Prepare driver canary plan + synthetic workload test for 2026-03-09 (owner: Samira Patel, due: 2026-03-06).
   - Run perf test for KV cache tuning with extended-chat traces; report findings (owner: Aisha Khan, due: 2026-03-10).
   - Short-term autoscaler tweak: lower scale-up cooldown from 300s -> 120s on critical pools (owner: infra team, assignee: Jordan Lee, due: 2026-03-07).
   - Draft customer-facing note for impacted customers (templated) in case routing incidents recur (owner: customer-success, assignee: Ethan Chen, due: 2026-03-09).

Open questions / to follow up:
- Which routes counted against API availability SLO - confirm inclusion/exclusion rules with product (linked: CONFLUENCE-RELIABILITY-2026-03).
- Did any partner dedicated deployments perform manual capacity additions during INC-4523? Need audit of capacity changes around 2026-03-02.
- Cost impact estimate if we enable warm-standby nodes for top 5 routes - owner: finance + infra to compute.

Prep checklist before sync:
- [ ] Pull updated MTD SLO dashboard and screenshot (Jordan).
- [ ] Confirm owner's availability for each follow-up action (Samira).
- [ ] Attach short incident summaries (INC-4523, INC-4550) to the agenda doc (Samira).
- [ ] Add the autoscaler change to staging for smoke test (Jordan/Ethan).

Notes to self / scratch thoughts:
- Consider a lightweight canary test harness that replays recent production traces against new routing rules before merge. Could be a s/w job in infra repo.
- If paging trend continues, propose increasing oncall headcount temporarily or moving to 2nd responder for high-burn weeks.

Bottom line: focus this week's sync on routing CI gate + driver canary readiness. Keep the review short and action-oriented.

-- Samira
